STUDENT PHOTOGRAPHY WORKSHOP
Campus Arts Club · Synthetic example

Join our workshop on November 10, 2026, in the student center.

Register using the club form by November 5, 2026. Pay the $15 materials fee by November 7, 2026. Registration does not include payment.

Bring your student ID to check in on November 10, 2026.

If you need accessibility accommodations, email the coordinator by next Friday.

Questions? Contact the club office. This notice is an invented example, not an actual campus announcement.

Application notice · Synthetic example

Applications close on December 8, 2026.

Use the membership form to apply. At the bottom of the same form, the printed deadline says December 11, 2026. This notice does not say which deadline is correct.

If your project uses the workshop, complete the safety orientation by December 15, 2026.

You do not need to pay a membership fee. An older payment request has been withdrawn.

Contact the club coordinator to clarify the application deadline. This is an invented notice for demonstration.
